recipe.title: Meringues
recipe.notes: This is Amy's recipe, from Jo Seagar's cookbook.

method.s: In a large metal, glass or porcelain bowl (not plastic, beat the egg whites until soft peaks form.
Gradually add the caster sugar, a teaspoon at a time. It should take 10 minutes to add the sugar and the mixture should be getting glossy, thick and shiny with each addition.
Beat in the vanilla, vinegar and cornflour.
Spoon the mixture into blobs on a lined baking tray.
Bake for about 45 minutes, until dry and crisp. The meringues should lift off the paper easily.
Cool on a wire rack, then serve with whipped cream and berry coulis.
